# Data Visualization
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(palmerpenguins)
penguins
```

```{r}
penguins |>
  select(bill_length_mm,
         flipper_length_mm,
         species)

ggplot(
  data = drop_na(penguins),
  mapping = aes(
    x = bill_length_mm, 
    y = flipper_length_mm,
    color = species,
    shape = sex)) +
  geom_point()
```

```{r}
ggplot(
  data = penguins, 
  mapping = aes(
    x = bill_length_mm,
    y = flipper_length_mm,
    color = species)) +
  geom_point(na.rm = TRUE) +
  theme_gray(base_size = 18)

penguins |>
  ggplot(aes(x = bill_length_mm,
             y = flipper_length_mm,
             color = species)) +
  geom_point(na.rm = TRUE) +
  theme_gray(base_size = 18)
```

```{r}
ggplot(data = penguins,
       mapping = aes(x = bill_length_mm, 
                     y = flipper_length_mm,
                     color = species)) +
  geom_point(na.rm = TRUE)


ggplot(data = penguins,
       mapping = aes(x = bill_length_mm, 
                     y = flipper_length_mm)) +
  geom_point(aes(color = species), na.rm = TRUE)
```
